content:
maria: FYI getting a CS escalation — multiple customers reporting 503s from hosted inference in us-west1.
jonathan: when did this start?
maria: ~14:02 UTC. Spikes in error-rate on hosted-gpu-pool-2, several timeouts then 503s. CS ticket CS-7890, CS-7891 opened.
kevin: looking at runner logs: repeated GPU resets followed by SIGSEGV in upstream worker. nvml shows memory blown out then driver reset.
sre-bot: [alert] fallback routing engaged (12% traffic) to smaller quant model.
alice: any quick mitigations applied already?
maria: ops scaled pool +4 nodes, enabled fallback routing, and bumped eviction threshold to reduce churn. CS notified.
jonathan: can we reproduce in staging? which request pattern triggered it?
kevin: reproduce steps I ran:
```
# on staging
python tools/send_requests.py --model llama-13b --batch-size 64 --seq-len 12000 --qps 300
kubectl logs -n infer runner-xyz --since=5m
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv
```
kevin: with that load the runner's GPU memory climbs to 100% then process crashes with `invalid read` in libattention.cu.
alice: I reproduced locally with the same script. After ~70s the container OOMs and restarts.
kevin: kernel log excerpt: "oom_kill_process: Killed process 2345 (runner) total-vm:..." then "sigsegv at 0x7f... in attention_kernel".
maria: impact: Acme and Helix customers observed elevated 503s and increased latency P95. Support has promised initial update.
support_lead: pls add impacted accounts to incident notice and offer credits. Also include workaround: set max_batch_size=32 or route to dedicated.
jonathan: for triage we need core dump, dmesg, cgroup usage and nvml logs. Suggest commands:
```
kubectl exec -n infer runner-xyz -- bash -lc 'cat /proc/$(pgrep runner)/limits > /tmp/limits.txt; dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg.txt'
kubectl cp infer/runner-xyz:/tmp/dmesg.txt ./dmesg-1749003100.txt
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1 > gpu-sample.log
```
kevin: also capture `gdb --batch -c core.dump -ex "bt full"` if we get a core.
alice: opened PR to throttle KV prefetch and reduce aggressive prefetch window — PR #1234 in review. Might prevent ballooning memory on longctx.
maria: assign owners: kevin -> kernel/gpu debugging and core analysis, alice -> runtime/patch, jonathan -> routing/fallback tuning, I'll do customer comms and postmortem.
jonathan: added a quick runbook entry to incidents wiki under incidents/2024/1749003100.
sre-bot: checkpoint created: snapshot-id snap-2024-08-05-1405 for pool hosted-gpu-pool-2.
kevin: next steps: collect core + logs, reproduce with smaller increments to identify threshold, test PR patch in staging.
support_lead: timeline for hotfix?
alice: aiming to land a safe configuration rollback today (reduce prefetch, cap batch-size) and deploy to staging for validation in ~2h.
maria: thanks — keep updates here. I'll push a brief customer update in 30m. :thumbsup:
